profile.title: Product Engineer
profile.summary: A product engineer working fully remotely from Hamamatsu, Shizuoka. I started out in backend development and now spend most of my time on the frontend with React and TypeScript, though depending on the period and the product I shift back into Node.js / Python (FastAPI) services or cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure. My strengths are owning the work end to end — from choosing the technology through design, implementation and operations — and putting in place the machinery a team develops with: CI, coding standards, branching strategy. Lately I've been interested in taking AI agents (Claude Code) beyond personal productivity and shaping them into something a whole team can use with consistent results.
profile.next: I want to stay a T-shaped engineer: frontend as the deep stem, but able to go and pick up whatever else a product needs. Going forward I want to work on development workflows designed around AI agents, on developer experience and the platforms that support it, and on technology selection and architecture — widening the range where I can support a team from the technical side.

KDDIアジャイル開発センター株式会社|2026-07.description: Building a new product as part of a scrum team. I set up a monorepo from scratch — a React / TypeScript / Vite SPA with a Python (FastAPI) and MongoDB backend — and made the conventions enforceable by configuration rather than prose, for example encoding the direction of dependencies (app → features → shared) as ESLint rules. I also built CI that only inspects the components that actually changed, and consolidated the guidelines for AI agents into a single AGENTS.md so the same rules apply whichever tool is used. In roughly the first month and a half I landed over 200 commits and launched three new services.

株式会社エムニ（業務委託）|2025-12.description: Working across frontend, backend and infrastructure on a generative-AI product. I design and build the RAG-based search layer and the UI around it, the post-processing of search results, the document sync pipeline, and the infrastructure in Terraform. I also built the clarification flow — when a question is vague, the system generates choices from documents that actually match and narrows things down — and the UI that shows the exact source page alongside each answer.

株式会社Hakky（業務委託）|2025-01.description: Working across frontend, backend and infrastructure on generative-AI systems. I design and build document analysis and review-support features driven by LLMs, multi-agent setups, a unified authentication layer, and the infrastructure in Terraform. On the review-support system roughly 68% of the repository's commits are mine, and it cut manual review effort by about 60%. I also evaluated and picked a lighter model with little accuracy loss, bringing AI running costs down to under a tenth.

株式会社ブイキューブ|2025-01.description: Frontend development for a BtoBtoC event-DX platform. In an Nx monorepo built on React, TypeScript and Vite, I handled the viewer screens from component design through implementation, and implemented real-time audio and video delivery with the Agora SDK.

株式会社ブイキューブ|2024-04.description: Backend and frontend development for a new webinar streaming product. Alongside the React viewer screens and audio/video delivery via the Agora SDK, I built the real-time synchronisation and event-driven architecture on Firebase (Firestore / Cloud Functions / Pub/Sub).

株式会社ブイキューブ|2023-04.description: Spent my first month or two in QA, writing E2E tests with Autify, then moved to the backend: infrastructure as code with AWS CDK, a serverless streaming pipeline on Lambda and MediaLive, production monitoring with CloudWatch, and CI/CD on CircleCI.

株式会社Diafa（業務委託）|2024-04.description: Built an information service covering concept cafés across Japan. It started as a personal project and grew into a contract engagement, where I owned everything from technology choices and architecture through to infrastructure. Alongside designing the AWS setup — including weighing App Runner against Amplify — I worked on performance, SEO, and building and running the CI/CD pipeline.

株式会社toraco（業務委託）|2024-12.description: Site development for a Wi-Fi rental business. I implemented the cart and checkout flow and maintained the existing system.

株式会社インフラトップ（DMM WEBCAMP / 業務委託）|2021-11.description: Tech mentor at a programming school: answering students' technical questions, reviewing code and helping them debug, supporting Rails and AWS (EC2, RDS) environment setup, and following their progress through the course.

エデュケーショナル・デザイン株式会社（業務委託）|2022-05.description: Mentor at an in-person programming school for students from elementary through high school. I taught programming using Minecraft and Scratch, and followed up on each student's progress at their own level.

I handled the entire process alone — client interviews and requirements, technology choices, design, implementation and operation — including task and schedule management features shaped around the client's workflow, and multi-device support.

01.title: Development workflows built around AI agents
01.body: I want agents like Claude Code to become a team standard rather than a personal productivity trick — a setup where anyone gets the same quality of result. Not by sharing prompts, but by building it into how the team works.

02.title: Practising agile, and building what it stands on
02.body: Working as part of a scrum team, I've put in place the machinery a team develops with: CI, coding standards, branching strategy. Next I want to help shape the process itself, so a team can keep shipping quickly and safely.

03.title: Technology selection and architecture
03.body: Frontend is my base, but I go and pick up whatever else a product needs, from backend through infrastructure. I want to grow that cross-domain judgement into something I can take on as design responsibility.
